verdict.rationale: AutoGen's docs cover every orchestration pattern in the story. Swarm uses HandoffMessage for handoffs, AgentTool wraps agents as subagents, and crew-style teams come via RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat, MagenticOneGroupChat and the GraphFlow directed-graph workflow. Community users report positive hands-on use of the group-chat examples; the complaint about output quality concerns model results, not whether orchestration works. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the newer 0.4 patterns (Swarm handoffs, GraphFlow, AgentTool) — the community reports appear to predate them.
